title: NASA flight surgeon on Apollo astronauts shunning Edgar Mitchell
place_text: Aquarius underwater base off Key Largo

tellings.quote:
I was
diving on the Aquarius wath base with a
NASA flight surgeon Who Remain unnamed

plain: In 2008 a NASA doctor told John Blitch that other astronauts from the Apollo moon missions had shunned Edgar Mitchell, an Apollo astronaut who walked on the moon. Blitch, a former scientist at a Pentagon research agency, says he heard this while diving with the doctor at Aquarius, an underwater research base off Key Largo, Florida, and he keeps the doctor's name to himself. The point is that Mitchell was pushed out by his own peers.
